sop_modules.name: Exterior Soffit Protection & Equipment Setup
sop_modules.description: Deploy ground protection below soffit work zone (landscape/hardscape — critical for overhead drip fallout), mask soffit-mounted light fixtures, mask adjacent finished fascia/frieze if already painted, set up ladders/scaffold and extension poles for overhead work.

tasks.name: Landscape Ground Protection Below Soffit
tasks.description: Deploy plastic sheeting and tarps over landscape areas directly below soffit work zone. CRITICAL for overhead work — gravity pulls all drips, roller spatter, and overspray straight down. Brush/roll: edge tarps at base. Spray (non-vented): full tarp coverage over entire drip zone.

quality_notes.all: Full coverage of plantings below soffit drip zone. Secure tarps against wind. Overhead work sends ALL drips straight down — no angled drift like vertical siding.

tasks.name: Hardscape Walkway Protection Below Soffit
tasks.description: Deploy canvas drop cloths and plastic over walkways and hardscape directly below soffit work area. Non-slip canvas for crew traffic areas.

quality_notes.all: Canvas for crew traffic. Plastic for spray overspray. Must be in place before any overhead work begins.

tasks.name: Soffit Light Fixture Masking
tasks.description: Mask soffit-mounted light fixtures — recessed lights, porch fixtures, soffit vent covers adjacent to work zone. Bag and tape or remove cover plate where accessible.

quality_notes.all: Complete coverage of all soffit-mounted fixtures on working elevation. Remove cover plates where accessible for clean edge.

tasks.name: Fascia Edge Masking
tasks.description: Apply tape and masking film along fascia-soffit junction to protect finished fascia from overhead roller spatter. Only needed when fascia is already painted (top-down sequence: if soffit is painted first, fascia is bare and needs no protection).

quality_notes.all: Tape + 12-inch masking film along fascia-soffit junction. Prevents roller spatter on finished fascia during overhead rolling. Skip if fascia is unfinished.

tasks.name: Brush/Roll Equipment Setup for Overhead Work
tasks.description: Set up ladders or scaffold per access_type. Stage extension poles for overhead roller application, brushes, roller trays, and materials. Extension pole is the primary overhead tool — reduces fatigue and improves coverage consistency.

quality_notes.all: Stage extension poles (4-8 ft) for overhead reach. Position ladder securely. Stage materials within reach at height.

tasks.name: Spray Equipment Setup for Overhead Work
tasks.description: Set up ladders or scaffold per access_type. Configure airless sprayer with 413-515 tip for overhead soffit application. Lower pressure settings for overhead work to control overspray. NON-VENTED SOFFIT ONLY.

quality_notes.all: Verify tip size: 413-515 for overhead application. Lower pressure than vertical work — reduces overspray fallout. Stage spray shield for edge control at fascia junction.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Landscape/hardscape protection first → Fixture and fascia masking → Equipment setup last. ALL ground protection must be in place before any overhead work begins.

sop_modules.name: Exterior Soffit Surface Preparation
sop_modules.description: NC soffit prep: low-pressure wash (NO power washing — damages thin panels, forces water into attic through vents), sand for adhesion (substrate-specific grit), seal fiber cement cut edges, fill defects, tannin spot-prime knots on wood, scuff-sand vinyl, caulk panel joints. All tasks are overhead.

tasks.name: Low-Pressure Wash Soffit Surface
tasks.description: Clean soffit underside with garden hose and soft bristle brush from ladder/scaffold. Remove construction dust, cobwebs, dirt. HIGH-PRESSURE POWER WASHING IS PROHIBITED on soffit — damages thin panel edges, strips factory primer on fiber cement, forces water into attic through vent openings (COMPAT-SFIT-010).

quality_notes.QT3: Full low-pressure wash. Allow 24 hr dry time before coating.
quality_notes.QT4: Full low-pressure wash with TSP/mildewcide solution. Allow 24-48 hr dry time.

tasks.name: Sand Wood Soffit for Adhesion
tasks.description: Sand bare wood soffit (T&G boards or plywood panels) with 80-120 grit for adhesion profile. Overhead sanding is slower and more fatiguing — hand blocks for T&G grooves, orbital sander for flat panels. Dust falls into eyes/lungs — proper PPE mandatory.

quality_notes.QT3: Full surface sand. T&G grooves hand-sanded.
quality_notes.QT4: Full surface sand with uniform scratch pattern. Inspect all T&G grooves.

tasks.name: Scuff Sand Fiber Cement Soffit
tasks.description: Light scuff sand factory-primed HardieSoffit panels with 150 grit for mechanical adhesion profile. Required on factory-primed surfaces to create tooth for field primer bond.

quality_notes.QT3: Light scuff. Not removing material — creating tooth.
quality_notes.QT4: Full surface scuff. Uniform scratch pattern overhead.

tasks.name: Scuff Sand Vinyl Soffit
tasks.description: Scuff-sand glossy vinyl soffit panels with 220 grit to create mechanical adhesion profile for bonding primer. Without scuff-sanding, bonding primer alone is insufficient — coating peels in sheets (RISK-SFIT-007).

quality_notes.all: Full surface scuff sand. Do not skip — bonding primer adhesion depends on mechanical tooth. Overhead work makes this slow.

tasks.name: End-Seal Fiber Cement Cut Edges
tasks.description: Brush end-cut sealer on ALL field-cut edges of HardieSoffit panels. Cut edges expose cellulose fibers that absorb water via capillary action — the primary failure mode for fiber cement soffit (FM-006 / RISK-SFIT-003). Includes panel butt joints, miters, and field cuts.

substrate_state_rules.notes: Factory primer covers face but cut edges are bare
Bare FC by convention — all edges need sealing

quality_notes.all: EVERY cut edge sealed. Non-negotiable for warranty and performance. Overhead position means condensation can pool at panel edges.

tasks.name: Spot-Prime Tannin Knots on Wood Soffit
tasks.description: Brush alkyd or shellac-based stain blocker onto visible knots on tannin-rich soffit boards (cedar, redwood, Douglas fir) BEFORE full acrylic primer coat. Prevents tannin bleed-through — brown staining most visible on flat white soffit finish (the most common soffit color). Overhead brush application per knot.

quality_notes.QT3: Spot-prime all visible knots and sap streaks.
quality_notes.QT4: All knots spot-primed. Inspect for missed tannin sources under bright light.

tasks.name: Caulk Soffit Panel Joints and Junctions
tasks.description: Apply exterior paintable caulk to soffit panel joints and soffit-to-fascia/frieze junctions. Use flexible polyurethane or siliconized acrylic caulk. Overhead caulking is slower — gravity pulls caulk from the bead. Caulk AFTER primer coat (COMPAT-SFIT-009: caulk adheres better to primed surfaces).

quality_notes.QT3: All panel joints and fascia/frieze junctions caulked. Smooth tool.
quality_notes.QT4: All joints caulked with consistent bead. Precision tool smooth overhead.

tasks.name: Prep Dust Cleanup
tasks.description: Remove sanding dust and debris from soffit surface before coating. Tack cloth overhead — dust falls away from surface when working overhead, but residual particles must be removed for adhesion.

quality_notes.all: All dust removed. Surface ready for primer application.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Low-pressure wash → Dry time (24-48 hr) → Sand (substrate-specific grit) → Seal FC cut edges → Spot-prime wood knots → Caulk joints (AFTER prime on wood/FC, concurrent with prep on vinyl) → Dust cleanup.

sop_modules.name: Exterior Soffit Prime Coat
sop_modules.description: Full field prime coat. Four substrate-driven primer paths: (1) acrylic primer for bare wood soffit and factory-primed fiber cement (SYS_EXT_SFIT_PRIMER_ACRYLIC), (2) alkali-resistant primer for bare fiber cement (SYS_EXT_SFIT_PRIMER_ALKALI), (3) bonding primer for vinyl (SYS_EXT_SFIT_PRIMER_BONDING), (4) SKIP when SS_EXT_PRIMED_FIELD. Spray eligible ONLY on non-vented soffit. Brush/roll is default for vented soffit.

tasks.name: Prime Coat — Brush/Roll Overhead Application
tasks.description: Apply full prime coat by brush and roller with extension pole overhead. Brush for fascia/frieze junctions and T&G grooves (wood), roller with extension pole for open field. Primer product determined by substrate state: acrylic (wood/factory-primed FC), alkali-resistant (bare FC), bonding (vinyl). Default method for all vented soffits.

quality_notes.QT3: Uniform coverage. Work primer into surface and T&G grooves. Maintain wet edge.
quality_notes.QT4: Perfect uniformity overhead. Inspect under raking light at 3 ft.

tasks.name: Prime Coat — Spray Overhead Application (Non-Vented Only)
tasks.description: Apply full prime coat by airless spray overhead. NON-VENTED SOFFIT ONLY — spray on vented soffit drives paint into attic through perforations (FM-001, COMPAT-SFIT-006). Lower pressure settings for overhead application to control overspray fallout. Primer product determined by substrate state.

quality_notes.QT3: Uniform mil build overhead. Consistent coverage.
quality_notes.QT4: Perfect uniformity. Inspect under raking light at 3 ft.

tasks.name: Bonding Primer — Brush/Roll on Vinyl Soffit
tasks.description: Apply bonding primer (SYS_EXT_SFIT_PRIMER_BONDING) by brush and roller with extension pole on vinyl soffit overhead. Chemical bond to non-porous PVC surface. RECOAT within 1 week — bonding primer loses flexibility if left exposed longer (RISK-SFIT-008).

quality_notes.all: Even coverage overhead. Thin coats — bonding primer sags easily overhead. Recoat within 1 week.

tasks.name: Bonding Primer — Spray on Vinyl Soffit (Non-Vented Only)
tasks.description: Apply bonding primer (SYS_EXT_SFIT_PRIMER_BONDING) by airless spray on non-vented vinyl soffit overhead. NON-VENTED ONLY.

quality_notes.all: Even coverage overhead. Lower pressure for overspray control. Recoat within 1 week.

tasks.name: Alkali-Resistant Primer — Brush/Roll on Bare Fiber Cement Soffit
tasks.description: Apply alkali-resistant primer (SYS_EXT_SFIT_PRIMER_ALKALI) by brush and roller on bare/damaged fiber cement soffit. Required when factory primer is absent or severely damaged (pH 13.0 — standard acrylic primer causes saponification).

quality_notes.all: Even coverage on porous bare FC. Higher material consumption overhead. Maintain wet edge.

tasks.name: Alkali-Resistant Primer — Spray on Bare FC Soffit (Non-Vented Only)
tasks.description: Apply alkali-resistant primer (SYS_EXT_SFIT_PRIMER_ALKALI) by airless spray on non-vented bare fiber cement soffit overhead. NON-VENTED ONLY.

quality_notes.all: Even coverage overhead. Lower pressure for overspray control on porous substrate.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Tannin spot-prime knots (wood only, done in prep) → Full field prime coat. Method by application_method dimension, gated by soffit_vent_type. Substrate state determines primer product. Module SKIPPED entirely when substrate_state = SS_EXT_PRIMED_FIELD.

sop_modules.name: Exterior Soffit Finish Coat 1
sop_modules.description: First finish coat overhead. Brush/roll with extension pole is default (all soffit types). Spray eligible ONLY for non-vented soffit (FM-001). T&G groove work requires brush even when spraying non-vented panels. Apply thin coats overhead to prevent sag.

tasks.name: Cut-In at Fascia/Frieze Junctions — Coat 1
tasks.description: Brush cut-in at fascia-soffit and frieze-soffit junctions. Clean edge line where soffit meets adjacent trim. Overhead brush detail work. Required for both brush/roll and spray methods — spray alone cannot achieve clean junction lines.

quality_notes.QT4: Crisp, precise cut-in line at 3 ft viewing standard.

tasks.name: Finish Coat 1 — Brush/Roll Overhead Application
tasks.description: Apply first finish coat by roller with extension pole for open field, brush for T&G grooves and edge detail. Thin coats overhead to prevent sag and drips (RISK-SFIT-006). Back-brush immediately after rolling to work paint into surface and catch drips. Default method for ALL vented soffits.

quality_notes.QT2: Even coverage overhead. No drips or sags.
quality_notes.QT3: Uniform coverage. Consistent roller texture. Maintain wet edge overhead. Work T&G grooves with brush.
quality_notes.QT4: Uniform appearance. No visible roller marks at 6 ft. T&G grooves fully coated.

tasks.name: Finish Coat 1 — Spray Overhead Application (Non-Vented Only)
tasks.description: Apply first finish coat by airless spray overhead. NON-VENTED SOFFIT ONLY (FM-001). Lower pressure settings for overhead. Tight fan pattern (413-515 tip) for controlled application. On T&G board soffit: brush-back grooves after spray pass while wet.

quality_notes.QT2: Even coverage. No drips or holidays.
quality_notes.QT3: Uniform mil build overhead. No visible spray pattern at 6 ft.
quality_notes.QT4: Uniform mil build. No visible pattern at 3 ft.

tasks.name: T&G Groove Brush-Back After Spray — Coat 1
tasks.description: Brush paint into tongue-and-groove board joints after spray pass while coating is wet. Spray alone does not penetrate T&G groove channels — brush work is required even on non-vented T&G board soffit. Two-person operation: sprayer leads, brusher follows.

quality_notes.all: Work paint into every groove joint while wet. Follow sprayer within 30-60 seconds. All groove channels must have full coverage.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Cut-in at fascia/frieze junctions → Spray or roll open field → T&G brush-back (spray + T&G only). QT2 may stop here (single finish coat on primed surfaces). Allow recoat time per product TDS before interstage.

sop_modules.name: Exterior Soffit Interstage Inspection
sop_modules.description: Inspect first finish coat overhead, touch up defects. Light sand at QT4 only (220 grit overhead). Module skipped for QT2 single-coat systems.

tasks.name: Interstage Inspection — Overhead
tasks.description: Inspect first finish coat from ladder/scaffold for holidays, runs, sags, drips, and coverage defects. Overhead inspection requires good lighting — headlamp or portable light angled to reveal defects.

quality_notes.QT3: Quick scan for obvious defects — runs, sags, holidays, drip marks.
quality_notes.QT4: Systematic inspection with raking light overhead. Mark all visible defects. Check T&G grooves for coverage.

tasks.name: Intercoat Light Sand — QT4 Only
tasks.description: Light sand between finish coats with 220 grit overhead for mechanical adhesion and leveling. QT4 only — not required at QT3. Overhead sanding is slow and fatiguing. Dust falls directly onto painter.

quality_notes.QT4: Light scuff sand overhead. Remove nibs, drip marks, and defects. Uniform scratch pattern.

tasks.name: Interstage Touch-Up
tasks.description: Brush touch-up of defects found during interstage inspection. Overhead brush detail work.

quality_notes.QT4: Fix all defects found during inspection. Blend repairs.

tasks.name: Intercoat Dust Removal
tasks.description: Remove sanding dust from soffit surface before second coat. Tack cloth overhead. QT4 only (follows intercoat sand).

quality_notes.all: All sanding dust removed before second finish coat.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Inspect → Sand (QT4 only) → Touch up → Dust removal → Coat 2. Module skipped for QT2 single-coat systems.
sop_modules.run_rule: Runs after finish coat 1, before finish coat 2. Skipped for QT2 single-coat.

sop_modules.name: Exterior Soffit Finish Coat 2
sop_modules.description: Second (final) finish coat overhead. Required at QT3 and QT4. Skipped at QT2 (single coat). Same method constraints as coat 1 — spray only on non-vented soffit.

tasks.name: Cut-In at Fascia/Frieze Junctions — Coat 2
tasks.description: Brush cut-in at fascia-soffit and frieze-soffit junctions for second coat. Final appearance coat — precision matters.

quality_notes.QT3: Straight, consistent cut-in line. Final coat.
quality_notes.QT4: Crisp, precise cut-in line at 3 ft viewing standard. Final appearance coat.

tasks.name: Finish Coat 2 — Brush/Roll Overhead Application
tasks.description: Apply second (final) finish coat by roller with extension pole and brush detail overhead. Thin coats to prevent sag. Final appearance coat. Default method for ALL vented soffits.

quality_notes.QT3: Even coverage. Consistent appearance. Maintain wet edge overhead.
quality_notes.QT4: Uniform appearance. No visible roller marks at 3 ft. Final appearance coat.

tasks.name: Finish Coat 2 — Spray Overhead Application (Non-Vented Only)
tasks.description: Apply second (final) finish coat by airless spray overhead. NON-VENTED SOFFIT ONLY. Final appearance coat.

quality_notes.QT4: Uniform mil build. No visible pattern at 3 ft. Final appearance coat.

tasks.name: T&G Groove Brush-Back After Spray — Coat 2
tasks.description: Brush paint into T&G groove joints after spray pass for second coat. Same technique as coat 1. Final coat — all grooves must have full coverage.

quality_notes.all: All groove channels fully coated. Follow sprayer within 30-60 seconds. Final appearance — no missed grooves.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Cut-in at junctions → Spray or roll open field → T&G brush-back (spray + T&G only). Second and final finish coat. Skipped at QT2.

sop_modules.name: Exterior Soffit Final Inspection
sop_modules.description: Final walkthrough of completed soffit finish. Overhead inspection for coverage, consistency, edge quality, and defects. Touch up as needed.

tasks.name: Final Walkthrough Inspection — Overhead
tasks.description: Walk all elevations and inspect finished soffit from ground level and ladder as needed. Check coverage, consistency, edge lines at fascia/frieze junctions, T&G groove coverage, and drip marks.

quality_notes.QT2: Ground-level walkthrough. Quick scan for misses and drip marks.
quality_notes.QT3: Ground-level walkthrough at 6-10 ft viewing distance. Check all elevations. Verify T&G groove coverage.
quality_notes.QT4: Ground-level with binoculars for upper elevations. 6 ft viewing standard. Raking light check on primary elevations. Verify edge line quality.

tasks.name: Final Touch-Up — Overhead
tasks.description: Brush touch-up of defects found during final inspection. Overhead detail work from ladder/scaffold.

quality_notes.QT2: Fix obvious misses and drip marks.
quality_notes.QT4: Fix every defect. Blend seamlessly at 3 ft standard.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Inspect all elevations from ground → Ladder touch-up overhead → Sign off.

sop_modules.name: Exterior Soffit Cleanup & Protection Teardown
sop_modules.description: Remove all ground protection, fascia masking, fixture masking. Clean equipment. Restore site.

tasks.name: Protection Material Removal
tasks.description: Remove all masking tape from fascia junction, landscape tarps, hardscape drop cloths, fixture bags. Check for tape residue on fascia.

quality_notes.all: Check for tape residue on finished fascia. Remove all protection materials completely. Inspect landscape for drip damage.

tasks.name: Clean Equipment
tasks.description: Clean rollers, brushes, extension poles. Flush airless sprayer if used (non-vented soffit). Clean tips and filters.

quality_notes.all: Full equipment clean. Flush sprayer if used. Extension poles cleaned and stored.

tasks.name: Site Debris Cleanup
tasks.description: Collect all debris — sandpaper, caulk tubes, tape, sealer containers, paint cans, roller covers, plastic sheeting. Leave site clean.

quality_notes.all: Site restored to pre-work condition. All materials and debris removed.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Protection teardown → Equipment cleaning → Site cleanup.

round_configurations.name: Prime + 2 Finish Coats
round_configurations.description: Standard NC sequence: 1 field prime + 2 finish coats. Required at QT3/QT4 on bare or factory-primed substrates.
round_configurations.notes: Standard residential soffit sequence. Field prime on FC is mandatory per Hardie warranty. Two finish coats for full coverage and durability.

round_configurations.name: Prime + 1 Finish Coat (Economy)
round_configurations.description: Economy QT2 sequence: 1 field prime + 1 finish coat.
round_configurations.notes: QT2 economy tier. Single finish coat acceptable on primed surfaces.

round_configurations.name: 2 Finish Coats Only (Field-Primed)
round_configurations.description: Skip prime, direct to 2 finish coats. For SS_EXT_PRIMED_FIELD only.
round_configurations.notes: Field prime already applied in prior mobilization.

round_configurations.name: 1 Finish Coat Only (Economy, Field-Primed)
round_configurations.description: Economy single finish coat on field-primed surface.
round_configurations.notes: QT2 economy on already-primed surface. Minimum viable scope.

key_soffit_differentiators: ALL tasks carry overhead work penalty (FAC_SFIT_OVERHEAD = 1.35) — the defining production characteristic
Spray tasks gated by soffit_vent_type = non_vented — vented soffit is brush/roll only (FM-001)
Extension pole is the primary overhead tool for brush/roll work — reduces fatigue
T&G groove brush-back tasks added for spray + tg_board combination
Fascia edge masking task for protecting finished adjacent trim
Four substrate-driven primer paths (acrylic, alkali, bonding, skip) — more than siding (3 paths)
Overhead ground protection is MORE critical than siding — drips fall straight down
Wind exclusion on spray tasks only — brush/roll is not wind-sensitive at soffit height

assumptions.value: Caulk soffit joints AFTER primer coat, not before
assumptions.note: Caulk adheres better to primed surfaces. Sequence: prep → prime → caulk → finish. Caulk task is in prep module but sequenced after prime in field execution.

assumptions.value: Low-pressure wash only (garden hose + soft brush) — power washing prohibited on soffit
assumptions.note: High pressure damages thin panel edges, strips factory primer on FC, forces water into attic through vents.

assumptions.value: Spray application tasks gated by soffit_vent_type = non_vented
assumptions.source: FM-001, COMPAT-SFIT-006 from materials.json; Exterior_Application_Methods_Doctrine.md Part A §6
assumptions.note: Spray on vented soffit drives paint into attic through perforations. Non-negotiable safety rule.

assumptions.value: T&G board soffit requires brush-back of grooves even when spraying non-vented panels
assumptions.source: Research RF-004, RF-005; Exterior_Application_Methods_Doctrine.md Part A §6 (T1-11 parallel)
assumptions.note: Doctrine covers T1-11 siding groove brush-back. Soffit T&G is parallel case — spray alone does not penetrate groove channels. Flagged as assumption.

assumptions.value: FAC_SFIT_OVERHEAD (1.35) applies to ALL tasks in this spec — soffit is 100% overhead
assumptions.note: Doctrine provides height modifiers but no explicit overhead work multiplier. 1.35 derived from research midpoint (25-40% penalty). Flag for field validation.

assumptions.value: Vinyl soffit uses SS_EXT_BARE_WOOD state by convention
assumptions.source: No dedicated SS_EXT_BARE_VINYL exists in Substrate_State_Reference.md
assumptions.note: May need a dedicated vinyl state in the future. For now, SS_EXT_BARE_WOOD is the closest match.
